notes: Ingredion Incorporated (NYSE: INGR) — global ingredient solutions company that processes corn, tapioca, potato, rice, and other grains/tubers into starches, sweeteners (HFCS, dextrose), specialty ingredients, plant-based proteins, and texturizers. Serves food, beverage, brewing, paper, and pharma customers. Four reporting segments since FY24: Texture & Healthful Solutions (T&HS), Food & Industrial Ingredients LATAM (F&II LATAM), Food & Industrial Ingredients US/Canada (F&II US/C), and All Other (incl. PureCircle stevia). Spun off South Korean operations / divested PureCircle stevia partially during FY24. Fiscal year = calendar. SEC CIK 1046257. 10-Ks at sec.gov.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue $5.99B. COVID disruption (food-service exposure ~30% LatAm). Adj op income $531M. Adj EBITDA ~$869M.
FY21: revenue $6.89B (+15%). Strong demand + price pass-through. Adj EBITDA ~$825M. Net debt $2.13B.
FY22: revenue $7.95B (+15%). Aggressive pricing offset corn/energy inflation. Adj EBITDA $999M. Adj EPS $7.34.
FY23: revenue $8.16B (+3%). Adj EBITDA $1.19B (+19%). Adj EPS $9.42. Strong margin recovery as input costs eased; price held.
FY24: revenue $7.42B (-9% — partly mix/divestitures + lower corn pass-through). Adj EBITDA $1.23B (+4%). Adj EPS $10.65. Sold South Korea biz. Net debt down to $893M (1.5x EBITDA). Strong FCF.
